# File description: 
# Runs data queries, builds a summary table of query counts, and exports an Excel file listing the flagged observations
# Excel file: each row includes observation KEY, the question the query relates to, and a brief description of the error

# Instructions:
# See make.r for how to execute code in correct order
# Before running this file, pull new data from API (./src/set-up/pull-data.R)

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(tibble)
library(haven)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(ggrepel)
library(openxlsx)
library(here)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(glue)
library(httr2)

# load helper functions
source(here("src", "monitoring", "helper-functions.R"))

# load data
dat <- readRDS(here("data", "facilityMNCH-toolA.rds"))
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character))

# Variable checks

## Section 1

*Data reporting processes*

```{r section1, results='asis'}
## ---- Step 1: define each condition as its own line -----------------------
## Each line below is one TRUE/FALSE condition per record.
## TRUE = this record has that specific inconsistency.

cond_q105  <- dat$q105 == "1" & as.numeric(dat$q105a) == 0
cond_neg_q105a <- as.numeric(dat$q105a) < 0
cond_q118  <- dat$q118 == "1" & as.numeric(dat$q119b) == 0
cond_neg_q119b <- as.numeric(dat$q119b) < 0
cond_q129  <- dat$q129 == "1" & as.numeric(dat$q131) == 0
cond_neg_q131  <- as.numeric(dat$q131) < 0

cond_q108_1a <- dat$q106_3 == "0" & dat$q108_1 %in% c("1","2","3","96")
cond_q108_1b <- dat$q106_3 == "1" & dat$q108_1 == "98"

cond_q108_2a <- dat$q106_4 == "0" & dat$q108_2 %in% c("1","2","3","96")
cond_q108_2b <- dat$q106_4 == "1" & dat$q108_2 == "98"

cond_q108_3a <- dat$q106_5 == "0" & dat$q108_3 %in% c("1","2","3","96")
cond_q108_3b <- dat$q106_5 == "1" & dat$q108_3 == "98"

cond_q107 <- (dat$q106_3 == "1" | dat$q106_4 == "1" | dat$q106_5 == "1") &
             (dat$q107_1 == "0" & dat$q107_2 == "0" & dat$q107_3 == "0" &
              dat$q107_4 == "0" & dat$q107_5 == "0")

cond_q110 <- (dat$q106_1 == "0" & dat$q106_2 == "0" & dat$q106_3 == "0" &
               dat$q106_4 == "0" & dat$q106_5 == "0") & dat$q110 == "1"

cond_q111 <- dat$q106_3 == "0" & !is.na(dat$q111) & dat$q111 != ""

cond_q112 <- dat$q106_4 == "0" & dat$q106_5 == "0" & !is.na(dat$q112) & dat$q112 != ""

cond_q113 <- dat$q106_1 == "0" & !is.na(dat$q113) & dat$q113 != ""

q119b_num <- as.numeric(dat$q119b)
cond_q119b_q120 <- !is.na(q119b_num) & q119b_num == 0 & dat$q120 %in% c("1","2","3","4", "5", "6")

cond_q124    <- dat$q123 == "1" & (is.na(dat$q124) | dat$q124 == "")

cond_q138 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q138 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5")
cond_q139 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q139 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")
cond_q140 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q140 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")
cond_q141 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q141 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")
cond_q142 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q142 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")
cond_q143 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q143 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")
cond_q144 <- dat$q135 == "0" & dat$q144 %in% c("1","2","3","4","5","6")

## ---- Step 2: metadata for each condition (question, label, issue text) ---
check_defs <- tribble(
  ~cond_name,       ~question,          ~label,                                 ~issue,
  "cond_q105",      "q105 / q105a",     "M&E validation visits",                "Q105 = 'Yes, validations conducted' but Q105a (count) = 0",
  "cond_neg_q105a", "q105a",            "M&E validation visits (count)",        "Q105a has a negative value",
  "cond_q118",      "q118 / q119b",     "Facilities reporting to this site",    "Q118 = 'Yes, other facilities report' but Q119b (count) = 0",
  "cond_neg_q119b", "q119b",            "Facilities reporting (count)",         "Q119b has a negative value",
  "cond_q129",      "q129 / q131",      "CHWs reporting to this site",          "Q129 = 'Yes, CHWs report' but Q131 (count) = 0",
  "cond_neg_q131",  "q131",             "CHWs reporting (count)",               "Q131 has a negative value",
  "cond_q108_1a",   "q106_3 / q108_1",  "Maternal death DHIS-2 deadline",       "Maternal deaths not recorded in DHIS-2 (Q106_3=No) but Q108_1 has a real deadline code",
  "cond_q108_1b",   "q106_3 / q108_1",  "Maternal death DHIS-2 deadline",       "Maternal deaths ARE recorded in DHIS-2 (Q106_3=Yes) but Q108_1 is coded 'Not applicable'",
  "cond_q108_2a",   "q106_4 / q108_2",  "Stillbirth DHIS-2 deadline",           "Stillbirths not recorded in DHIS-2 (Q106_4=No) but Q108_2 has a real deadline code",
  "cond_q108_2b",   "q106_4 / q108_2",  "Stillbirth DHIS-2 deadline",           "Stillbirths ARE recorded in DHIS-2 (Q106_4=Yes) but Q108_2 is coded 'Not applicable'",
  "cond_q108_3a",   "q106_5 / q108_3",  "Neonatal death DHIS-2 deadline",       "Neonatal deaths not recorded in DHIS-2 (Q106_5=No) but Q108_3 has a real deadline code",
  "cond_q108_3b",   "q106_5 / q108_3",  "Neonatal death DHIS-2 deadline",       "Neonatal deaths ARE recorded in DHIS-2 (Q106_5=Yes) but Q108_3 is coded 'Not applicable'",
  "cond_q107",      "q106 / q107",      "Death identification source",          "A death type is recorded in DHIS-2 but no identification source is selected in Q107",
  "cond_q110",      "q106 / q110",      "Designated data compiler",             "No events recorded in DHIS-2 at all, but Q110 says a designated compiler exists",
  "cond_q111",      "q106_3 / q111",    "Maternal death compiler",              "Maternal deaths not recorded in DHIS-2 but Q111 (who compiles them) is not blank",
  "cond_q112",      "q106_4-5 / q112",  "Stillbirth/neonatal death compiler",   "Neither stillbirths nor neonatal deaths recorded in DHIS-2 but Q112 (who compiles them) is not blank",
  "cond_q113",      "q106_1 / q113",    "Pregnancy compiler",                   "Pregnancies not recorded in DHIS-2 but Q113 (who compiles them) is not blank",
  "cond_q119b_q120","q119b / q120",     "Reporting facility count vs frequency","Q119b (number of facilities) = 0 but Q120 (reporting frequency) still has a value",
  "cond_q124",      "q123 / q124",      "Submission deadline",                  "Q123 = 'Yes, there is a deadline' but Q124 (when the deadline is) is blank",
  "cond_q138",      "q135 / q138",      "Reporting destination",                "Q135 = 'does not report upward' but a destination is recorded in Q138",
  "cond_q139",      "q135 / q139",      "LGA reporting frequency",              "Q135 = 'does not report upward' but Q139 (LGA reporting frequency) still has a value",
  "cond_q140",      "q135 / q140",      "State reporting frequency",            "Q135 = 'does not report upward' but Q140 (State reporting frequency) still has a value",
  "cond_q141",      "q135 / q141",      "National reporting frequency",         "Q135 = 'does not report upward' but Q141 (National reporting frequency) still has a value",
  "cond_q142",      "q135 / q142",      "MoH dept. reporting frequency",        "Q135 = 'does not report upward' but Q142 still has a value",
  "cond_q143",      "q135 / q143",      "NGO/institution reporting frequency",  "Q135 = 'does not report upward' but Q143 still has a value",
  "cond_q144",      "q135 / q144",      "Other destination reporting frequency","Q135 = 'does not report upward' but Q144 still has a value"
)

conditions <- list(
  cond_q105 = cond_q105, cond_q118 = cond_q118, cond_q129 = cond_q129,
  cond_neg_q105a = cond_neg_q105a, cond_neg_q119b = cond_neg_q119b, cond_neg_q131 =   cond_neg_q131,
  cond_q108_1a = cond_q108_1a, cond_q108_1b = cond_q108_1b,
  cond_q108_2a = cond_q108_2a, cond_q108_2b = cond_q108_2b,
  cond_q108_3a = cond_q108_3a, cond_q108_3b = cond_q108_3b,
  cond_q107 = cond_q107, cond_q110 = cond_q110,
  cond_q111 = cond_q111, cond_q112 = cond_q112, cond_q113 = cond_q113,
  cond_q119b_q120 = cond_q119b_q120, cond_q124 = cond_q124, cond_q138 = cond_q138,
  cond_q139 = cond_q139, cond_q140 = cond_q140, cond_q141 = cond_q141,
  cond_q142 = cond_q142, cond_q143 = cond_q143, cond_q144 = cond_q144
)

## ---- Step 3: turn each TRUE condition into table rows ---------------------
section1_results <- check_defs %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(cond_name, question, label, issue) {
    flagged <- which(conditions[[cond_name]])
    if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      KEY = dat$KEY[flagged],
      g03 = dat$g03[flagged],
      question       = question,
      label          = label,
      issue          = issue
    )
  })

# summary table
section1_results %>%
  select(question, label, issue) %>%
  group_by(question, label, issue) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  compact_kable(caption = "Query summary table for section 1 ")

```

## Section 2

*Indicator availability*

```{r section2-indicator-availability, results='asis'}
## ---- Step 1: build the list of indicator variable names -----------------
gen_suffixes <- function(n) {
  base <- letters
  if (n <= 26) return(base[seq_len(n)])
  extra <- paste0(letters[seq_len(n - 26)], letters[seq_len(n - 26)])
  c(base, extra)
}

s2_blocks <- tribble(
  ~stem,  ~n_items,
  "q201", 9,
  "q202", 5,
  "q203", 20,
  "q204", 15,
  "q205", 31,
  "q206", 5,
  "q207", 32,
  "q208", 5,
  "q209", 4,
  "q210", 8,
  "q211", 4
)

indicator_vars <- s2_blocks %>%
  pmap(function(stem, n_items) paste0(stem, gen_suffixes(n_items))) %>%
  unlist()

## ---- Step 2: for each indicator/source pair, check multiple issue types --
section2_results <- map_dfr(indicator_vars, function(v) {
  sv <- paste0(v, "_source")
  if (!all(c(v, sv) %in% names(dat))) return(NULL)

  ind_val <- dat[[v]]
  src_val <- dat[[sv]]

  ## Indicator = No, but a source is still selected
  flagged <- which(ind_val == "0" & !is.na(src_val) & src_val != "")
  if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)

  tibble(
    KEY   = dat$KEY[flagged],
    g03 = dat$g03[flagged],
    question       = paste0(v, " / ", sv),
    label          = "Indicator vs. data source",
    issue          = glue("{v} = 'No' but a data source is selected in {sv}")
  )
})

## ---- Documentation hierarchy: can't document WHEN something happened -----
## without documenting THAT it happened at all
hierarchy_pairs <- tribble(
  ~base_var, ~timing_var, ~label,
  "q207b", "q207c", "Skin-to-skin contact",
  "q207d", "q207e", "Breastfeeding",
  "q207f", "q207g", "Vitamin K prophylaxis",
  "q207h", "q207i", "Eye care",
  "q207j", "q207k", "Chlorhexidine application"
)

hierarchy_results <- hierarchy_pairs %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(base_var, timing_var, label) {
    flagged <- which(dat[[base_var]] == "0" & dat[[timing_var]] == "1")
    if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      KEY   = dat$KEY[flagged],
      g03 = dat$g03[flagged],
      question       = paste0(base_var, " / ", timing_var),
      label          = paste0(label, " timing"),
      issue          = glue("{base_var} = 'No' (not documented at all) but {timing_var} = 'Yes' (timing within 1st hour is documented)")
    )
  })

section2_results <- bind_rows(section2_results, hierarchy_results)

# summary table
section2_results %>%
  select(question, label, issue) %>%
  group_by(question, label, issue) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  compact_kable(caption = "Query summary table for section 2")
```

## Section 3

*Indicator completeness*

```{r section3-completeness-checks, results='asis'}
## Check 1: photo AND reason both present (contradiction)
register_pairs <- tribble(
  ~photo_var, ~reason_var, ~label,
  "q301", "q301_reason", "Antenatal care (ANC) register",
  "q302", "q302_reason", "Labor and delivery ward register",
  "q303", "q303_reason", "Postnatal ward register",
  "q304", "q304_reason", "Newborn unit register",
  "q305", "q305_reason", "Operating theater register",
  "q306", "q306_reason", "Postabortion care (PAC) register",
  "q307", "q307_reason", "PMTCT register",
  "q308", "q308_reason", "Discharge register",
  "q309", "q309_reason", "Referral register",
  "q310", "q310_reason", "Death register"
)

photo_reason_conflict <- register_pairs %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(photo_var, reason_var, label) {
    flagged <- which(!is.na(dat[[photo_var]]) & dat[[photo_var]] != "" &
                      !is.na(dat[[reason_var]]) & dat[[reason_var]] != "")
    if (length(flagged) == 0) return(NULL)
    tibble(
      KEY = dat$KEY[flagged], 
      g03 = dat$g03[flagged],
      question = paste0(photo_var, " / ", reason_var), label = label,
      issue = glue("Both a photo ({photo_var}) and a 'reason not uploaded' ({reason_var}) are present — should be mutually exclusive")
    )
  })

## Check 2: GPS plausibility
lat <- as.numeric(dat$`gps-Latitude`)
lon <- as.numeric(dat$`gps-Longitude`)
flagged_gps <- which(!is.na(lat) & !is.na(lon) & !(lat >= 9.0 & lat <= 13.0 & lon >= 7.0 & lon <= 12.0))

gps_results <- tibble(
  KEY = dat$KEY[flagged_gps], 
  g03 = dat$g03[flagged_gps],
  question = "gps-Latitude / gps-Longitude", label = "GPS location",
  issue = "GPS coordinates fall outside the expected Kano/Gombe bounding box"
)

section3_results <- bind_rows(photo_reason_conflict, gps_results)

# summary table
section3_results %>%
  select(question, label, issue) %>%
  group_by(question, label, issue) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  compact_kable(caption = "Query summary table for section 3")

```

```{r export_excel}
var_key <- tibble::tribble(
  ~variable,      ~description,
  "key",       "KEY to identify observation",
  "interviewer_id",  "Variable g03",
  "question",   "question number in tool",
  "label",    "question label",
  "issue",       "description of issue"
)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "section1")
writeData(wb, "section1", section1_results)

addWorksheet(wb, "section2")
writeData(wb, "section2", section2_results)

addWorksheet(wb, "section3")
writeData(wb, "section3", section3_results)

addWorksheet(wb, "variable-key")
writeData(wb, "variable-key", var_key)
setColWidths(wb, "variable-key", cols = 1:2, widths = c(18, 100))

fn_save_dated_workbook(wb, "data-queries-toolA")

```
